metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - Puts forth full practice
metadata.description: Dobbins (hip) was listed as a full participant on Thursday's injury report.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins sustained an apparent hamstring injury in Sunday's victory over the Jaguars and was ultimately limited at Wednesday's session with a hip issue, but with him getting in a full session Thursday neither is an issue any longer. Backfield mate RJ Harvey (hamstring) also practiced fully Thursday while rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) sat out a second straight day,

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logs full practice session Thursday
metadata.description: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins is expected to be good to go for Week 3 after being upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. RJ Harvey (hamstring) was also able to practice in full, but rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) was absent, so it looks like Denver's backfield is still expected to be at less than full strength in Week 3.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - Set for another practice
metadata.description: Dobbins (hip) was spotted on the field for the media-access portion of Thursday's practice, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins opened Week 3 prep as a limited participant Wednesday, so if he can upgrade to full activity Thursday, it would clear up any concern about his status heading into Sunday's game against the Rams. He's one of three Denver running backs on the injury report this week, as RJ Harvey (hamstring) was limited and Jonah Coleman (ankle) didn't participate in the team's first practice of the week.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) limited at practice Wednesday
metadata.description: J.K. Dobbins (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins was a officially a limited participant for the Broncos on Wednesday due to a hip injury that he recently suffered. It looks like he will have a good chance to play through it in Week 3, and he will be primed for more work than usual if one or both of RJ Harvey (hamstring) and Jonah Coleman (ankle) are sidelined against the Rams on Sunday night.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - Limited Wednesday
metadata.description: Dobbins (hip) was limited at practice Wednesday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: As for the other injured Broncos running backs, RJ Harvey (hamstring) also was a limited participant, while Jonah Coleman didn't practice due to a sprained ankle. Dobbins himself suffered what was termed a hamstring injury during the team's Week 2 win against the Jaguars, but it was reclassified as a hip issue on Denver's first Week 3 practice report. He'll now have two more practices to prove his health ahead of the weekend.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins (hamstring) seen practicing Wednesday
metadata.description: J.K. Dobbins (hamstring) was seen practicing for the Broncos on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins was seen at practice on Wednesday after recently suffering a minor hamstring injury of some kind. It looks like he may be well enough to play through it in Week 3, but it's too early to say for sure. RJ Harvey (hamstring) and Jonah Coleman (ankle) both seem to be trending the right way as well, which may lead to a crowded backfield for Denver this week.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - On track to practice in Week 3
metadata.description: Dobbins, who exited Sunday's 20-13 win over the Jaguars due to a hamstring injury, is expected to practice this week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins logged 21 snaps and carried 10 times for 36 yards Sunday before checking out of the game late in the third quarter when the hamstring issue cropped up. Initial evaluations on Dobbins' hamstring indicated that he avoided any sort of major injury, and he looks like he'll have a chance at suiting up this weekend against the Rams if he continues to make progress over the next few days. The Broncos will issue their first Week 3 injury report later Wednesday, when the extent of Dobbins' participation in practice will be revealed.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins (hamstring) to practice this week
metadata.description: Broncos RB J.K. Dobbins is expected to practice this week.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins receive good news on the hamstring injury he suffered. The entire Broncos backfield is banged up with RJ Harvey and Jonah Coleman also battling injuries.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins Limited in First Practice of the Week
metadata.description: Denver Broncos running back J.K. Dobbins (hamstring), who was pulled from the Week 2 win against the Jacksonville Jaguars due to hamstring cramping and did not return, was listed as limited for the first practice of the week on Wednesday, according to the team. RJ Harvey (hamstring), who was inactive on Sunday, was also limited, while rookie fourth-rounder Jonah Coleman (ankle) did not practice after taking over lead-back duties against the Jags in just his second NFL game. Coleman became a popular waiver-wire pickup this week after he scored his first rushing touchdown in the team's home opener. Denver's backfield is now completely up in the air with all three backs injured, but there is optimism that Dobbins will be able to suit up this weekend on Sunday night against the visiting Los Angeles Rams. With the Broncos' backfield picture hazy right now, it is hard to recommend Dobbins as anything more than an RB3/flex option coming off his hamstring injury. The 27-year-old's lengthy injury history and the Broncos' poor start on offense this year have not endeared Dobbins to many fantasy managers yet. He is going to need to play better to hold off a healthy Coleman this year.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins Battled Leg Cramps in Week 2
metadata.description: Denver Broncos running back J.K. Dobbins (leg) suffered from leg cramps in Week 2 rather than a hamstring injury, as originally reported, per Mike Klis of 9NEWS. Klis writes that there is "optimism the team dodged a serious setback." The reporting from Klis further confirms speculation that Dobbins avoided a major injury and should be available for Denver's Week 3 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. The 27-year-old has had a quiet start to the season, recording 72 rushing yards on 18 carries across two games. If fellow Broncos back RJ Harvey (hamstring) can return from the hamstring injury that sidelined him in Week 2, Denver could operate a three-way backfield split between Dobbins, Harvey, and rookie Jonah Coleman. With the workloads uncertain for all three Broncos backs, fantasy managers may want to avoid starting any of them in Week 3.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins (hamstring) avoids major injury
metadata.description: J.K. Dobbins is reportedly "good" after injuring his hamstring in Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins was unable to finish Sunday's win over Jacksonville. His status will need to be monitored in practice this week. Rookie RB Jonah Coleman took over the backfield to finish Sunday's game RJ Harvey (hamstring) sidelined.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - Looking good after hamstring scare
metadata.description: The Broncos believe that Dobbins' injured hamstring is "good" heading into next Sunday's game against the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.
metadata.analysis: The latest news on Dobbins aligns with what James Palmer of Bleacher Report previously relayed following the Broncos' 20-13 win over the Jaguars on Sunday, when Dobbins made an early exit due to a "slight" hamstring issue. While the Broncos are optimistic that Dobbins won't have to miss any time, his activity during practices Wednesday through Friday will ultimately determine whether he suits up against the Rams. Denver could have all of its key backfield members available for Week 3, as head coach Sean Payton suggested during his press conference Monday that RJ Harvey (hamstring) could return to action after sitting out against the Jaguars, per Nick Kosmider of The Athletic.

metadata.title: J.K. Dobbins - Hoping to play Week 3
metadata.description: The Broncos are optimistic that Dobbins sustained only a minor hamstring injury during Sunday's 20-13 win over the Jaguars and will be available to play Week 3 versus the Rams, James Palmer of Bleacher Report reports.
metadata.analysis: Dobbins has been far from a picture of durability during his seven-year NFL career, but early indications are that his latest setback on the health front isn't anything significant. The Broncos haven't provided word that Dobbins will be sent in for an MRI, and the team will likely use his activity in practices Wednesday through Friday to determine his availability heading into next Sunday's game. With RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive against the Jaguars and with Dobbins making an early exit, rookie Jonah Coleman (10 carries for 39 yards and a touchdown, three catches for 19 yards) ended up finishing the contest as the Broncos' top option out of the backfield.
